subject: United Kingdom
note: Every number is measured by us from one pinned outline: the GSHHG v2.3.7 full-resolution land outline of Great Britain (49,153 points). A ruler of fixed length is walked once round the outline from its first point, counting steps (the divider method), with distances on a sphere of radius 6,371 km. These are measurements of that outline, not official coast lengths, and the walk stops where the last full step ends, so the figure is a lower bound for each ruler. No published figure is used.

claims.text: Following every point of the outline gives 10,127 km.
A 500 km ruler walked round Great Britain takes 2 steps, 1,000 km.
A 200 km ruler takes 12 steps, 2,400 km.
A 100 km ruler takes 28 steps, 2,800 km.
A 50 km ruler takes 69 steps, 3,450 km.
A 25 km ruler takes 175 steps, 4,375 km.
A 10 km ruler takes 559 steps, 5,590 km.
